pages.text: A $(item)Three-Light Signal$() guards its section like any signal, and shows $(l)yellow$() while it's clear but the next signal on is red. Trains pass a yellow at $(l)caution speed$() (40 km/h, a server setting) and keep to it until the next signal, slowing in time; they speed up again if it turns green.$(br2)A comparator reads 15, 7 or 0 for red, yellow or green.
Green, yellow and red, with a train beyond the red.

Mix them with two-light signals as you like: a three-light signal looks at whatever kind of signal comes next. Put them where trains need warning: before a station's platform signal, or on a fast main line.$(br2)The gauges show a yellow ahead, and caution speed as the speed limit.
